description: Return the latest completed bucket for one (exchange, symbol), at the key plan's interval (1 minute on Ultra and PAYG, 5 minutes otherwise): a `values` object mapping each column key to its measured number (or null when not observed), plus the window END timestamp `ts` in epoch milliseconds. Omit `columns` to get every column your plan includes; pass a subset of column keys (from blackforge_catalog) to narrow the payload. Columns your plan does not cover are dropped and reported in `columnsOmitted` so you can see why a key is absent. WHEN PRESENT, a `quality` object reports the row's measurement quality: `flags` names what went wrong during the window and `contaminates` lists which figures it flags, with a plain-English `qualityNote` beside it. Read it before trusting an unusual value. A `quality.raw` of 32768 means the row predates the quality rail and was never assessed; that is unknown, not bad. When the key is absent, the row carries no quality assessment at all.

columns.description: Optional subset of column keys from blackforge_catalog. Omit for all plan-included columns.

symbol.description: Trading pair from blackforge_symbols, e.g. BTCUSDT.

name: blackforge_latest
